newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen zone firms lead B index up at noon.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen zone firms lead B index up at noon.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index climbed higher at noon on Friday on strong performance by companies based in the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, analysts said.
The index rose 0.31 points or 0.18 percent to 176.10 on turnover of HK$65.9 million.
"Shenzhen-based companies' stocks are doing really well as the Hong Kong handover nears," an analyst at China Guotai Securities said.
Shenzhen Properties and Resources was the best performer, rising HK$0.09 or 2.30 percent to HK$4.01.
Four other Shenzhen-based companies came in the top eight as the Hong Kong handover draws near, analysts said.
People are expecting Shenzhen, bordering Hong Kong, to benefit from the handover, the Guotai analyst said.
Analysts said the index rise was also a reaction against the recent technical correction.
"The index had corrected a fair bit," an analyst at China Southern Securities said. "But judging by the small trading volume, I am not sure whether this rally indicates the end of the consolidation."
The A share index gained 3.05 points or 0.63 percent to 484.55 on turnover of 7.89 billion yuan.
Conglomerate Shenzhen Gintian Co was the most actively traded and rose 0.70 yuan or 6.1 percent to 12.14 yuan on volume of 16.3 million shares.
